decision.explanation: The provided evidence (pmid-9462753) exclusively describes the ETV6-NTRK3 gene fusion in congenital fibrosarcoma. It contains no data regarding the FLT3 gene, the D648K variant, the drug Gilteritinib, or any predictive sensitivity/response relationship in cancer. The evidence is insufficient to assess the claim.

citations.quote: This is the first study showing the ETV6-NTRK3 gene fusion in congenital fibrosarcoma (CFS). Using cytogenetic and FISH analyses, a novel t(12;15)(p13;q25) rearrangement was identified in CFS cases (3 of 4, including 1 case likely presenting overgrowth of normal fibroblasts). Mapping of breakpoints and mRNA analysis revealed that the translocation gives rise to the ETV6-NTRK3 fusion transcript, consisting of the HLH dimerization domain of ETV6 fused to the kinase domain of NTRK3. This aberration was absent in adult-type fibrosarcoma (ATFS, 2 cases) and infantile fibromatosis (IFB, 15 cases).
This is the first study describing the involvement of NTRK proteins in human oncogenesis and ETV6 gene fusion in solid tumors and proposing ETV6-NTRK3 as a diagnostic biomarker for CFS.
